aggregate_output_content_hash.formula: sha256( sort_by_relative_path( "sha256sum(relative_path_file)  relative_path" for every *.json under the output_namespace directory ) joined by newline, then sha256 of that joined text )
aggregate_output_content_hash.shell_equivalent: find . -name '*.json' | sed 's|^\./||' | sort | xargs sha256sum | sort -k2 | sha256sum
aggregate_output_content_hash.purpose: Pins the identity of the 120 calibration outputs this manifest depends on, WITHOUT embedding any observed real_lambda_ref/derived_high_pressure value -- a validation run recomputes this over its own local artifacts/real_vllm/calibration/rq6/<hash>/ directory and refuses to proceed on mismatch (scripts/real_vllm/run_rq6_validation.py's --skip-calibration-aggregate-check is engineering-only, for local dry-run/smoke use, never for a scientific launch).

calibration_dependency.per_cell_check: Each of the 240 validation cells additionally verifies its own window's calibration_manifest_sha256 and window_content_sha256 individually at load time (robustbench.real_llm.rq6_validation.load_calibrated_scale) -- the aggregate hash above is a whole-dependency freshness gate, not a substitute for the per-cell check.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (Wulver gres gpu:a100_10g:1 -- unchanged from the validated calibration campaign)

dimensions.window: 40 per source, all frozen HIGH_PRESSURE windows, no subsampling

task_matrix.replicates_per_cell_status: EXPLICITLY_FROZEN_FOR_RQ6_BY_AUTHOR_DECISION (2026-09-03): 1 execution per (policy, source, window) cell; inferential resampling unit = WINDOW (40 per source). This RQ6-specific decision supersedes earlier generic guidance (≥5 repetitions per cell; repetition-level bootstrap) only for the final RQ6 protocol. Rationale: the experimental unit for RQ6 is the workload window; uncertainty is estimated by resampling across the 40 independent windows per source (mirroring Phase-12); repeating an identical window predominantly samples transient engine jitter rather than additional workload-level uncertainty; the RQ6 estimand is sign/rank/reversal portability across windows, not a separate stochastic-engine variance component. Decision frozen before any real-system RQ6 result exists.
task_matrix.candidate_scale_source: Per cell, candidate_scale = the (source, window)'s calibration output's own derived_high_pressure field (already = 1.5 x real_lambda_ref, matching the HIGH_PRESSURE region factor) -- never re-derived, never assumed.
task_matrix.array_index_mapping: enumerate_validation_cells returns cells sorted by (source, window_id, policy); array index i always names the same cell across resubmissions given unchanged workload manifests.

slai_faithful.note: Engine flags held identical to vllm_faithful (only the scheduler differs) so the comparison isolates the policy, not incidental engine configuration -- an engineering decision, not a scientific parameter (docs/REAL_VLLM_SLAI_FIDELITY.md does not specify chunked-prefill/prefix-caching status for slai_faithful; holding them constant across both arms is the conservative, disclosed choice).

output_token_execution_contract.note: Unchanged from the calibration protocol (configs/real_vllm/rq6_calibration_manifest_v2_20260903.json's output_token_execution_contract) -- reused, not re-derived.

timing_transformation.formula: real_arrival_i = base_relative_arrival_i / s;  real_slo_deadline_i = real_arrival_i + (base_slo_deadline_i - base_relative_arrival_i) / s

episode_reset_contract.note: Unchanged from calibration (configs/real_vllm/rq6_calibration_manifest_v2_20260903.json's episode_reset_contract) -- sequential wait-for-all-responses replay, reset barrier via /metrics, --no-enable-prefix-caching. One window per cell, one cell per Slurm array task, one server start per task (never reused across cells, unlike calibration's 120-windows-per-task-run design -- each validation cell is its own Slurm array task, see run_rq6_validation.sbatch).

port_strategy.mechanism: robustbench.real_llm.port_alloc.allocate_port -- OS-assigned free ephemeral port via bind((host, 0)), not the calibration launcher's buggy PORT=8100+task_id%100 arithmetic (root-caused port collision, task 19 vs 119, docs/LSSP_NEW_CHAT_HANDOFF_20260903.md).
port_strategy.collision_safety: OS guarantees the assigned port is free at bind time, for any number of concurrently-scheduled array tasks on one node -- not bounded by a fixed modulus like the calibration scheme.

timeout_and_retry.note: server_ready_timeout_s/per_request_timeout_s unchanged from the validated calibration runner defaults (scripts/real_vllm/run_rq6_calibration.py) -- engineering parameters, not scientific ones; a validation cell that fails after retries is written as a FAILED-status output (never silently dropped), per the output contract.

statistics.experimental_unit: window (40 per source, block-bootstrapped, matching Phase-12's own window-level resampling)
statistics.multiple_testing_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05 over the 4-test family (2 reversal-condition + 2 stable-control-condition tests) (robustbench.ranking_portability.analysis.stats.benjamini_hochberg, reused)
